evidence: Independent evaluation of the displayed closed form agrees with direct signed-coloring enumeration for n=1,2,3 and q=1,3,5.
The transfer matrix M=J-I has the stated spectral power formula; splitting admissible endpoint colors into diagonal and off-diagonal cases yields the recorded closed form.
For q>2, even n is immediate from positivity of f and g; for odd n, (q-1)f-g=q(q-2)^2 and (q-1)^n >= q-1 prove S_n>0. S_n(2)=1+(-1)^n gives the claimed odd-n root at 2.
The headline all-n zero-free half-line is analytic and does not rely on the finite Sturm census.

Targeted checks of the cited signed-chromatic literature found fixed signed complete/Petersen families, generic Tutte zero-free regions, signed book graphs, and join/threshold families, but no formula for this one-edge subdivision family F_n or its sharp real barrier 2.
No priority claim is made beyond the exact F_n closed form and resulting real-root statement.
The exact infinite-family formula and sharp uniform real barrier are reusable signed-chromatic data, stronger and more informative than a finite census.

checks: Direct brute-force signed-coloring counts for n=1,2,3 and q=1,3,5 matched the formula.
